eps.o: Karen navigates life after her release. Wendy and Eddie adjust to a new normal. Old friends and lingering tensions resurface at a Washington Wizards game hosted by new-to-town WAG Courtney. Tia is presented with rumors about her personal life and is forced to face some hard truths.
